description: This file defines the InteropHelper class, providing methods to interact with an interoperation API within the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods for health checks, managing parties, transactions, quotes, transfers, and other interop-related operations, primarily for integration testing purposes.

classes.name: InteropHelper
classes.description: Helper class for testing interoperation API operations including party management, transactions, quotes, transfers, and health checks.
